title: Training Note: The Lined-Work Rush Premium at Marlowe & Finch Alterations
content:
**Rule.** On a Marlowe & Finch Alterations ticket accepted with rush service, a lined-work rush premium applies: 15 percent when the ticket carries two or more lined surcharge charges, 10 percent when it carries exactly one, and none when it carries no lined surcharge charge.

| Lined surcharge charges on the ticket | Lined-work rush premium |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 15 percent |
| exactly 1 | 10 percent |
| none | none |

## Questions answered by the rule

**What decides the premium — the number of lined surcharge charges or their amounts?** The number. A ticket with one lined surcharge charge of 3.60 USD and a ticket with one of 21.25 USD both take 10 percent.

**Does an operation charge count towards the premium?** No. Only lined surcharge charges are counted; a ticket with four operation charges and no lined surcharge charge has no lined-work rush premium.

**Where does the threshold between 10 and 15 percent lie?** At two: one lined surcharge charge gives 10 percent, two give 15 percent, and three or more still give 15 percent.

## Hypothetical cases

| Ticket | Operation charges | Lined surcharge charges | Premium |
|---|---|---|---|
| Unlined trousers, hem and waist | 2 | 0 | none |
| Lined skirt, hem only | 1 | 1 | 10 percent |
| Lined dress, hem, bodice and straps, each lined | 3 | 3 | 15 percent |
